messages:
Anya K: Heads-up — watching elevated streaming handshake p99 in eu-west1 since ~05:30 UTC. Embeddings endpoints look fine but streaming handshakes spiked and some 502/503 returned.
Jamal (oncall): Yep, saw the alerts. Grafana panel (streaming-handshake) shows spike at 05:31 and a coincident burst of pod restarts on node gpu-uk-17.
Sre-bot: Alert: STREAM_HANDSHAKE_5XX firing for eu-west1 (p99=2.1s, errors=12m). Incident created if escalation continues.
Lucy: Quick log check — sidecar TLS logs show repeated `handshake_timeout=1500ms` exceeded. Blackbox exporter config was toggled to http2 for websockets last night; that might be worse under node pressure.
Mike L: I rolled an exporter tweak late — enabled http2 probing for websocket endpoints to match the new runtime. Rolling back to http1 for eu-west1 to validate.
Jamal (oncall): Also seeing kubelet OOM kills on several GPU pods, memory spiking at the same time. Looks like KV-cache priming thrash when synthetic canaries ramp.
Anya K: That matches our synthetic churn — we ramped heartbeat rate in eu-west1 at 05:29 (sample_weight=5) to exercise cold KV priming. Action: reduce to 1 and enable prefix caching to avoid repeated full-model priming.
Lucy: Proposed blackbox module snippet to lower handshake fragility and timeout (drop-in for prometheus config):
```
modules:
  ws_stable:
    prober: http
    timeout: 3s
    http:
      method: GET
      headers:
        Upgrade: websocket
    tls_config:
      insecure_skip_verify: true
```
Also, switch back to http1 for probes that exercise the websocket upgrade handshake under pod memory pressure.
Mike L: Rolling back http2 -> http1 now for blackbox exporter in eu-west1. Command: `kubectl -n monitoring set env ds/blackbox-exporter PROBE_HTTP2=false` then restart.
ops-runner: Note: synthetic traffic contributes to billing. Reducing sample_weight also reduces noise and cost :money_with_wings:. Consider capping bursts during priming.
Jamal (oncall): Suggest alert tuning: STREAM_HANDSHAKE_5XX should require a 10m window and impact on >=3 distinct hosts before paging. This will reduce paging for short-lived priming spikes.
Anya K: Agreed. I'll add a composite dashboard panel: "probe stability score" = weighted(p99_handshake, 5xx_rate, gpu_pod_restarts) so we can triage faster. After rollback, watch for 10m and if stable we'll update runbook.
Sre-bot: Action created: INC-2026-834 assigned to Jamal (oncall). Next update scheduled in 10m.
Mike L: Rollback completed. Initial telemetry looks better — p99 down to ~350ms and errors falling. I'll open a PR linking the exporter config change and the rollback runbook.
Anya K: Thanks. Follow-ups: update runbook with KV-cache priming checklist, add a knob `max_sample_weight=2` to prevent aggressive synthetic ramps, and include steps for "if kubelet OOM observed": drain node, cordon, recreate MIG profile. I'll file the runbook PR after verification.
